experiment: R0 interior point masking ONLY AFTER APPROVAL
mask_population: core only; finite raw below 65535; uniform without replacement
estimated_support: allowed only with explicit provenance; report separately
comparison_rule: report both orders; no tuning or selecting best using held-out error
acceptance: report requested denominator and every unresolved position; no accuracy claim from this pilot alone
claim_scope: Conditional recovery of recorded observations only; not error-free truth or anomaly detection validation
coverage_failure_action: Any unresolved masked point fails coverage gate; retain it and do not widen support limits post hoc
accuracy_gate: No scientifically justified physical error tolerance yet; report errors without calling accuracy accepted
mask_implementation: For each seed and region, select 2 distinct core positions uniformly; k=1 uses first, k=2 uses both; do not construct masks until approved
separate_results: Each reference, k, seed, order; background and dynamic strata separately; no inferential treatment of repeated seeds as independent heats

sampling.region_ordinal: index in lexicographically sorted frozen reference IDs

reference_manifest_source.path: 04_Q1光谱研究/实验验证/R0点遮蔽审批准备_v1/reference_manifest_pending.json

permission_model: Separate human approval record; all parameters and dependencies bound before actual sampling
reference_flag_interpretation: approved=false in the original immutable source manifest means historical pending status; current permission ONLY via separate scoped approval
repeat_accounting: Per run keep points; every summary grouping reports unique (reference_id,loaded_row,loaded_column), excess repeated occurrences and positions used more than once; nested k, seeds and orders remain correlated
